sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to guess a wording from the verse (disgrace vs stranger vs mystery). Card 15 only told 'horror and an offense', so nothing earlier lets the baker reason their way to 'disgrace'. Picking the right word is luck, and it is the 'guess the next words of a line' kind of question the docs rule out for prophecy.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
